snippet.title: Monsters and Me | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
💀 MONSTERS AND ME — FIRST LOOK TRAILER 💥
🧟‍♂️ Wishlist now on Steam: https://bit.ly/MonstersAndMe

Monsters and Me is a chaotic 2D top-down shooter where you blast through endless waves of slime-mutated freaks, upgrade a ridiculous arsenal, and try not to die (again).

🎮 Fast rounds. Big guns. Dumb jokes.
Play solo or in local co-op as one of four survivors. Turn on the power, grab your gear, and fight your way through randomized waves of mayhem.

🔫 Features include:
• 18 weapons + 3 upgrade levels each
• 12 specials + 3 upgrade levels each
• 5 perks, 4 playable characters
• Pixel gore, arcade vibes, and short-session madness

🧠 Randomized runs = endless replayability
😂 Comedic cutscenes = streamer bait

📌 Wishlist on Steam: https://bit.ly/MonstersAndMe
🗣 Follow the developers on X: https://x.com/Ghettoconspi
